sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United welcome Alsager Town to home soil on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, bidding to extend their impressive recent run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five games (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches, while Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's struggling sides with just 4 points from 10 games and a recent streak of five consecutive defeats.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town in a fixture where the visitors will be desperate to build on their recent win, though Stafford's draws in their last two matches suggest some momentum loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two sides showing contrasting form—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six while Eccleshall have lost their most recent outing. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a top-half encounter, with the Casuals looking to bounce back after their draw last time out. In-form Bilston Town (five unbeaten) visit Foley Meir in another competitive mid-table tie. New Mills entertain struggling Market Drayton Town (five defeats in nine games), while Shawbury United, rooted in the bottom half with just one win in their last six, face Barnton at home. Crewe, also near the foot of the table, host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two sides with recent mixed form. Finally, Brereton Social welcome winless Widnes Town to what should be a more competitive match than Widnes' league position—currently on points 2—might suggest.
